content: syn_row1v3's A (82558fe, 2359 s, checkpoint_a) cannot be reused for a B-only run: with the whole chain run.py snapshots the (empty, row 1) map at A's final stamp at the start of B (backend.snapshot(prev_final)), which the evaluation reads as the state before B; a B-only call has no prev_final, so that snapshot is missing, and the RNG starts fresh. Not equivalent: the whole row is re-run (A + B).
flat.yaml as published (synthetic default config), input every frame at 680x480.
